mapper.sql: select task_id, task_code, workorder_id, workorder_code, process_id, process_code, process_name, workstation_id, workstation_name, plan_quantity, completed_quantity, qualified_quantity, defective_quantity, status, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, operator_id, operator_name, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pro_task
mapper.insert: insert into pro_task ( task_code, workorder_id, workorder_code, process_id, process_code, process_name, workstation_id, workstation_name, plan_quantity, status, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, operator_id, operator_name, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{taskCode}, #{workorderId}, #{workorderCode}, #{processId}, #{processCode}, #{processName}, #{workstationId}, #{workstationName}, #{planQuantity}, 'PENDING', #{planStartTime}, #{planEndTime}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update pro_task set status = #{status},
actual_start_time = sysdate(),
actual_end_time = sysdate(),
update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}

update pro_task set completed_quantity = completed_quantity + #{qty}, status = case when completed_quantity + #{qty} >= plan_quantity then 'COMPLETED' else status end, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_code as taskCode, t.workorder_id as workorderId, t.workorder_code as workorderCode, t.process_id as processId, t.process_code as processCode, t.process_name as processName, t.workstation_id as workstationId, t.workstation_name as workstationName, t.plan_quantity as planQuantity, t.completed_quantity as completedQuantity, t.qualified_quantity as qualifiedQuantity, t.defective_quantity as defectiveQuantity, t.status, t.operator_id as operatorId, t.operator_name as operatorName, w.item_name as itemName, w.specification as specification, round(ifnull(t.completed_quantity / t.plan_quantity * 100, 0), 1) as progress from pro_task t left join pro_workorder w on t.workorder_id = w.workorder_id where (t.task_code = #{barcode} or t.workorder_code = #{barcode} or t.process_code = #{barcode}) and t.status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') limit 1

select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_code as taskCode, t.workorder_code as workorderCode, t.process_name as processName, t.workstation_name as workstationName, t.plan_quantity as planQuantity, t.completed_quantity as completedQuantity, t.status, w.item_name as itemName, round(ifnull(t.completed_quantity / t.plan_quantity * 100, 0), 1) as progress from pro_task t left join pro_workorder w on t.workorder_id = w.workorder_id where t.operator_id = #{operatorId} and t.status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') order by t.status = 'PROCESSING' desc, t.plan_start_time asc
